file.description: <repoKey>:<repo-relative path>, the key one of the configured repos bound to <repos> (or workspace)

line.description: 1-indexed line, or null if the finding is about the file as a whole

category.description: The first four are functional, the next seven code quality, and design is for the designer. The prompt that pointed you here says which defect goes in which

why.description: Concrete failure scenario, or the named house rule broken. Not 'this is unconventional'.

confidence.description: How sure you are AFTER trying to refute your own finding

summary.description: Two or three sentences on the overall quality of the change
